'''Trigger''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They wore [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] with [[Color/Legends|purple]] markings.<ref name="Adventures" />
